$comment: Kun Fayakun Intelligence's interface (src/ai/ui): the panel, its answer blocks, the model on this device and the settings. Loaded with the interface's own chunk, the first time Ask is pressed. Plain and honest: the guide works on every device with no download; a model is only ever downloaded when the visitor asks, after seeing its size, licence and source.
ai.ui.title: Kun Fayakun Intelligence
ai.ui.intro: Ask about what you see, or tell the app what to show. Everything is worked out in this browser. Facts, numbers and scripture come from the app’s verified data, never from a model.
ai.ui.startFailed: The assistant could not start. Close this and press Ask again.
ai.ui.input.label: Your question or command
ai.ui.input.placeholder: Ask, or say what to show…
ai.ui.input.hint: Enter sends. Shift and Enter starts a new line. Up to 600 characters.
ai.ui.engine.label: Answering
ai.ui.by.browser: Explanation by this browser’s built-in model, on this device
ai.ui.by.anyModel: Explanation by a language model, on this device
ai.ui.flags.title: Changed before it was shown
ai.ui.flag.unchecked: {count, plural, one {# number in this explanation was} other {# numbers in this explanation were}} not found in the data, so marked “not checked”.
ai.ui.flag.arabic-removed: Arabic script was removed: scripture is shown only from the app’s data.
ai.ui.flag.other-script: Writing in another script was removed: the assistant answers in English.
ai.ui.flag.scripture-quote: A quotation that looked like scripture was removed: verses are shown only from the app’s data.
ai.ui.flag.unknown-citation: A reference that is not in the app’s data was removed.
ai.ui.flag.banned-phrase: Wording that claimed more than science and scripture show was changed.
ai.ui.flag.action-claim: A claim to have done something the app did not report was removed.
ai.ui.flag.scripture-reading: A sentence that said more about a verse or hadith than the app’s data says was removed.
ai.ui.flag.confirm-offer: An offer to confirm something that was not waiting for you was removed.
ai.ui.flag.injected-text: Words passing on an instruction found in the data were removed.
ai.ui.flag.repeated: A sentence the model wrote more than once is shown once.
ai.ui.flag.truncated: The explanation reached its length limit and was cut short.
ai.ui.kind.scripture: Scripture, shown from the app’s verified data
ai.ui.kind.explanation: Explanation, from the app’s own notes
ai.ui.facts.caption: From the app’s data and calculators
ai.ui.compare.caption: Simulation: a thought experiment, integrated ahead {days} days
ai.ui.compare.noEvents: No collisions, escapes or break-ups in the changed run.
ai.ui.compare.energy: Energy error of each run (the smaller, the more the run can be trusted): as it is {baseline}, changed {variant}.
ai.ui.action.label: In the app
ai.ui.action.experiment: Experiment: nothing changes until you confirm
ai.ui.action.status.not-confirmed: Sent, but the app did not show the change in time.
ai.ui.action.status.refused: Not done: it cannot be done here.
ai.ui.model.title: Model on this device
ai.ui.model.lead: The guide answers without any download. A language model can write fuller explanations. It runs in this browser, and is downloaded only if you choose it here.
ai.ui.model.checking: Checking what this device can run. Nothing is downloaded.
ai.ui.model.webgpuYes: WebGPU, which the models need, is available.
ai.ui.model.webgpuNo: WebGPU, which the models need, is not available here.
ai.ui.model.budget: Graphics memory a model may use beside the scene: about {size}.
ai.ui.model.memory: Device memory, as the browser reports it: {size}.
ai.ui.model.memoryUnknown: The browser does not say how much memory this device has.
ai.ui.model.none: No model is suggested for this device. The guide answers everything it can.
ai.ui.model.larger: Larger than suggested for this device. It may not fit beside the scene, may be slow, or may stop the page.
ai.ui.model.gpu: Graphics memory while it runs: about {size}
ai.ui.model.source: Comes from: huggingface.co (the model’s files) and cdn.jsdelivr.net (its compiled code). No account is needed.
ai.ui.model.ip: Hugging Face and jsDelivr will see your IP address, as any site you download from does.
ai.ui.model.stays: It stays stored in this browser, so it downloads once. You can delete it below at any time.
ai.ui.model.metered: This looks like mobile data or a data saver. {name} is a {size} download. Download it anyway?
ai.ui.model.maybeMetered: This browser does not say what connection this is, so you may be on mobile data. {name} is a {size} download. Download it anyway?
ai.ui.model.ready: {name} is ready, and answers your next question.
ai.ui.model.cancelled: Stopped. What was already fetched is kept for next time.
ai.ui.model.usingGuide: The guide answers: no model is in use.
ai.ui.model.browserNote: It comes with the browser, not from this app, and works in English only.
ai.ui.model.storedNone: No model is stored in this browser.
ai.ui.model.persist: Ask the browser to keep stored models
ai.ui.model.persistYes: The browser agreed to keep them.
ai.ui.model.persistNo: The browser did not agree, so it may remove them when space runs low.
ai.ui.settings.title: Settings
ai.ui.settings.levelNote: How much a model’s explanations assume. The guide’s own words stay the same.
ai.ui.settings.memoryNote: Off unless you turn it on. When on, each question and its answer are kept in this browser’s storage on this device, and nowhere else: they are shown again when you come back, and a model reads the last few as the conversation so far. Turning it off or clearing the conversation deletes them.
